proposal.description: While strikes are outstanding, Green_LED flashes in antiphase with the Red_LED1 strike blink instead of staying solid, because the designer read 'show both' as 'alternate them'
proposal.reason: During the clean-run window (strike_level non-zero, S_SS or S_RUN, no live fault), Green_LED goes dark on every lit half of the blink, where the header requires Green and Red_LED1 to be lit together.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is driven by the coarse any-fault summary instead of the OTP condition alone
proposal.reason: When UVLO is live or the latch is set (latch_state or latch_assert) and OTP is not, Red_LED2 lights and reports over-temperature that is not there.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is also lit by the SCR latch readback, as if a latched board had lost its input
proposal.reason: When latch_state is set and input UVLO is not live, Red_LED3 lights next to the solid Red_LED1, which falsely reports input undervoltage.

proposal.description: Power-good LED samples the comparator only at each blink half-period terminal count, to hide chatter, instead of following it on every clock
proposal.reason: A change on pgood reaches pgood_LED up to LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks late, and a pgood pulse or dropout shorter than a half-period that falls between terminal counts never shows.
